text:
Priya Nair: Quick report — new onboarding sample (vite + cloudflare worker) started crashing for new users after we changed package exports. Error in the browser console: 'Uncaught TypeError: Failed to resolve module specifier "@redwood/inference"'. Repro: clone sample-apps/onboard-quickstart, yarn install, yarn dev.

Owen Li: I can repro with esbuild and wrangler dev. The exports map uses conditional import/require and points to dist/esm/index.mjs but worker resolver appears to not honor the import condition, it tries to load the package root and fails. Vite/worker bundling is sensitive to package.json shapes.

Ben Wright: Also getting TS/IDE complaints — editor shows red squiggles: cannot find declaration file for module '@redwood/inference'. We removed top-level "types" in the last publish, which broke editor DX for consumers who rely on package types.

Priya Nair: Temporary workaround for users: add this to vite config: 
```
resolve: { alias: { '@redwood/inference': '/node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/esm/index.mjs' } }
```
But that's awful for onboarding and not viable for Cloudflare Deploy.

Owen Li: Thought: some runtimes expect a "default" or "browser" field in exports. Current exports look like: 
```
"exports": { ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs" }, "./package.json": "./package.json" }
```
Edge/bundler heuristics will fall through if they don't match the conditional fields. We should add a default and browser-compatible mapping. Also consider explicit subpaths for internal helpers (e.g., "./auth", "./retry") that some consumers import directly.

Ben Wright: For types, quick fix is add top-level "types": "dist/index.d.ts" and also reference in exports via "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" under the "." entry. We'll need to ensure d.ts is emitted in the esm build output.

Priya Nair: I inspected the ESM bundle — the RetryableAuth class isn't exported in dist/esm/index.mjs (it was tree-shaken because rollup marked the auth util as external). That's why runtime throws when sample apps call auth.wrapRetry.

Owen Li: Rollup config change idea: include /src/auth/** in the ESM input or mark it not external. Alternatively split auth into its own entry and add explicit export in package exports ("./auth": {"import": "./dist/esm/auth.mjs","require": "./dist/cjs/auth.cjs"}).


docs-bot: CI #612 — sample-apps/onboard-quickstart — FAILED. Log excerpt: 
```
Error: Module resolution failed: Could not resolve '@redwood/inference' (vite)
 at resolver.resolve (/virtual/loader.js:...)
```
Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/612 (internal)

Ben Wright: Proposal for package.json patch (minimal):
```
"types": "dist/index.d.ts",
"main": "dist/cjs/index.cjs",
"module": "dist/esm/index.mjs",
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "default": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs"
  },
  "./auth": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/auth.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/auth.cjs"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
This should cover node bundlers, edge runtimes, and restore types for editors.

Priya Nair: Action items: 
- Ben: open PR to publish a patch (v0.14.2) with the package.json fixes + add types entry.
- Owen: update rollup build to ensure auth/retry files are included in ESM bundle OR produce auth.mjs as a separate artifact.
- Me (Priya): add a short onboarding note and a temporary Vite alias snippet in the quickstart readme so new users aren't blocked.

Ben Wright: Will also add a small smoke test in sample-apps that runs a worker dev build to catch regressions.

Owen Li: I'll verify against Node 16/18, esbuild, vite, wrangler and Cloudflare worker runtime. If any runtime still fails we can add the explicit ./auth export as required.

Priya Nair: Thanks — surprised this slipped through. Onboarding funnel metrics showed a spike in first-run failures yesterday. Let's keep the patch quick. :pray:
